Pump cup service

The pump cup is the leather washer on the end of the plunger. When it is dry it will not seal
and the customer reports "the pump does nothing". Oil the pump cup with 3 drops of
Clearburn pump oil every 10 fills; tell the customer this on the return note, because it is the
one piece of maintenance that stops most Northstars coming back.
1. Unscrew the pump cap a quarter turn and withdraw the plunger.
2. Inspect the cup. A cup that is cracked or glazed hard is replaced (part P-CUP2); one
that is merely dry is oiled.
3. Put 3 drops of pump oil on the cup and work it in with your thumb until it is pliable.
4. Refit and pump 10 strokes. The resistance should build by the fourth stroke.
Mantle replacement
Mantles are consumables and are not a warranty item. The Northstar takes two mantles, part
M-21, sold as a 2-pack. A mantle with a hole, a tear or a dark patch is replaced; one that is
simply grey is fine.

Globe
The Northstar globe is part G-ND2. A cracked globe is replaced; a smoked one is cleaned
with the glass cleaner and a paper towel, never with anything abrasive. Fit the globe with the
Lantern Supply mark facing the control valve so the customer can read the dial through it.
Beacon 600 (LS-600)
The Beacon 600 runs on four D cells and almost never has an electrical fault beyond
corroded contacts. The faults we see are a cracked globe, a globe gasket that has let water in,
and contacts corroded by a cell left in too long. Tools: a Phillips #2, contact cleaner, the fibre
contact brush, and the gasket pick.

Northstar Dual-Fuel (LS-ND2)

The Northstar is our most repaired product by a wide margin, which is a function of how
many we sell and of how it is used, not of any weakness. Nearly every Northstar fault is one
of four things: a clogged generator, a dry pump cup, a torn mantle, or the wrong fuel. Ask
about the fuel first. The Northstar burns Clearburn white gas or unleaded gasoline. It does
not burn kerosene, and a tank that has had kerosene in it will have a varnished generator
and a sticky check valve. That is a paid repair even inside the warranty period.
Tools for the Northstar bench: 11 mm and 13 mm open-ended wrenches, the generator
wrench (part T-ND2, the thin 9 mm one with the bent handle), a small flat screwdriver, the
pump cup oil bottle, a nylon brush, and the torque driver set to 2.5 N·m for checking.
Generator tube replacement
The generator (part G-GEN2) is the tube that runs up through the burner and carries fuel
from the tank to the mantles. Signs of a bad generator are a weak yellow flame that will not
steady, pulsing light, and a tank that holds pressure but will not deliver it. The part is
$13.00, so a typical generator replacement on a yellow tag comes to $38.00 with the bench
fee.

## Training

Every new hire spends their first week in the Frederick showroom, whatever their role, learning the
products by using them: lighting a Northstar, trimming a wick on a Hagerstown Kerosene Lantern,
charging and running down a Firefly 220R, and taking a Sentinel 1000 apart as far as the light
panels. Showroom and support staff then complete the product knowledge course in Trainual, in
nine modules, within 30 days, and pass a 40-question check at 80% or better. The course is
refreshed each February when the catalog changes.

Warehouse and repair staff complete fuel handling certification before they handle fuel
unsupervised, usually in the second week, and repeat it every three years. Forklift operators in
Hagerstown are certified by Denise Okafor and recertified every three years as OSHA requires.
Repair technicians train for twelve weeks under Walt Brannigan before they sign off a repair on
their own, starting with LED products and ending with the Northstar.

## Performance reviews

Reviews happen once a year, in January, before the pay reviews in February, with a short check-in
in July. Your manager writes the review in Gusto, you add your own comments, and you meet for
about 45 minutes. Reviews cover the work itself, how you treat customers and colleagues, and
safety. Nobody should be surprised by anything in a review; if a concern is serious enough to go in
writing in January, it was raised in person earlier.

Showroom associates are also measured on the mystery-shop visits a contractor makes to each
showroom four times a year. The report comes to the showroom manager and is shared with the team;
it is a coaching tool, not a disciplinary one, unless it shows a safety or honesty problem.

## Fuel

### Can I burn kerosene in the Northstar?

No. The Northstar Dual-Fuel burns Clearburn white gas or unleaded gasoline only. Kerosene or
lamp oil will clog its generator in a single evening and the damage is not covered by warranty.

### What fuel goes in the Heritage No. 7?

Clearburn lamp oil only. Kerosene will burn but smokes, smells, and voids the 10-year warranty.
